title: Records and Statements Rule: The Yearly Statement Allowance of a Personal Sender Account and Statement Timing
content:
**Yearly statement allowance step.** For a statement requested on a Personal Sender Account, the step counts the statements requested on the account in the 12 months before the request date, an entry dated on the same calendar day 12 months earlier or before it no longer counting, plus the statement now requested. When that count reaches the yearly number of statements of the level held, 2 business days are added to the counted statement window; when it is below that number but more than half of it, 1 business day is added to the counted statement window; when it is half of that number or less, nothing is added for the yearly statement allowance.

## Yearly number of statements by level, and the resulting tiers

| Level held on the request date | Statements per rolling 12 months | Count (including this one) that adds 2 business days | Count that adds 1 business day | Count that adds nothing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paloma Starter | 2 | 2 or more | — | 1 |
| Paloma Verified | 4 | 4 or more | 3 | 1 or 2 |
| Paloma Verified Plus | 6 | 6 or more | 4 or 5 | 1 to 3 |
| Paloma Enhanced | 6 | 6 or more | 4 or 5 | 1 to 3 |
| Paloma Premier | 12 | 12 or more | 7 to 11 | 1 to 6 |
| Paloma Private Client | 12 | 12 or more | 7 to 11 | 1 to 6 |

At Paloma Starter no count lies strictly between half of 2 and 2, so the middle tier is empty there.

## Points of judgement

- **The statement now requested is counted.** A customer at Paloma Verified Plus with 3 statement requests in the 12 months has a count of 4 with the new one: more than half of 6 and below 6, so 1 business day is added.
- **Exactly half adds nothing.** At Paloma Verified a count of 2 including the new request is half of 4, so nothing is added; a count of 3 adds 1 business day.
- **The level held on the request date decides the yearly number.** The same history read against Paloma Premier's 12 statements adds nothing where Paloma Verified's 4 would add 2 business days.
- **The window.** Hypothetical dates: for a request on 15 June, a statement request dated 16 June of the year before counts; one dated 15 June of the year before no longer counts.
